ZPM Containment Breach
The Zero Point Module's quantum vacuum extraction chamber has suffered a catastrophic containment failure: The Zero‑Point Module was left unshielded beneath open sky.
The ZPM's naquadah-enhanced control crystals have been severely damaged by the quantum backlash, requiring extensive repairs before the device can safely resume zero-point energy extraction operations.
